definitions: In cloud computing, a virtual private cloud (VPC) is a private subset of a public cloud that allows users to provision a logically isolated section of the public cloud to launch resources in a virtual network that they define.
A network configuration that provides a private, isolated section of a public cloud, enabling users to define their own virtual network topology.
examples: We configured a new VPC for the application.
Security groups are often associated with a VPC.
Each VPC can have multiple subnets.
